papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Empowered Trajectory Tracking Control for Autonomous Vehicles: A Survey on Applications, Frameworks, and Future Trends
papers.reason: The paper concerns AI-based autonomous-vehicle control and does not study human participants or human cognition.

papers.title: Cognitive impairment and associated factors among adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus in eastern Sudan: a cross-sectional study
papers.reason: The study assesses cognitive impairment in a clinical human population using MoCA and regression but includes no interactive task, eye tracking, EEG, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: Combined hyperbaric oxygen and repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for vascular cognitive impairment: a randomized controlled trail
papers.reason: This human VCI trial uses cognitive scales and fNIRS to evaluate treatment but does not employ a qualifying interactive task, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or cognitive generative model.

papers.title: Effects of a short-term, low-frequency occupational participation programme on health-related quality of life in community-dwelling older adults: A multicentre quasi-experimental study
papers.reason: The intervention measures MoCA only as a secondary outcome and contains none of the qualifying behavioural, eye-tracking, EEG, or computational-modelling methods.

papers.title: Diet–gut microbiota–immune–brain interactions in aging: mechanistic pathways and clinical implications
papers.reason: This narrative review addresses cognitive aging and possible clinical monitoring but contains no qualifying task, eye tracking, EEG methodology, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: RobustPDx: A Structured Web-Based Parkinson’s Assessment Dataset and Benchmark for AI Robustness to Device Type and Handedness
papers.reason: Human participants complete structured web-based motor and working-memory tasks that yield interaction-level digital biomarkers, but the dataset lacks eye tracking, EEG, and cognitive process modelling.

papers.title: Present-Biased Preferences Associated with Socioeconomic Status in Intertemporal Decision-Making: Evidence from Behavioral and Electroencephalographic Measures
papers.reason: The study combines repeated human intertemporal choices with hierarchical Bayesian estimation of delay discounting and softmax choice consistency, while its EEG analysis is limited to ERP amplitudes rather than frequency or connectivity methods.

papers.title: Altered cognitive performance is associated with auditory cortex functional connectivity in patients with unilateral sensorineural hearing loss
papers.reason: The study centrally analyses directional EEG source connectivity with sLORETA and partial Granger causality in patients and controls, but the described oddball condition does not establish qualifying interactive decision-making.

papers.title: A Comprehensive Benchmark of EEG-Based BCI Deep Learning Models for MCI and Dementia Classification
papers.reason: The title indicates clinically relevant human EEG classification, but no summary is provided to demonstrate frequency-domain or connectivity analysis or any other qualifying element.

papers.title: Multiscale entropy is related to iron status in resting state EEG data
papers.reason: The title describes resting-state EEG entropy related to iron status, with no evidence of executive-function assessment, interactive behaviour, spectral or connectivity analysis, eye tracking, or cognitive modelling.

papers.title: Neurophysiological and autonomic effects of Cognitive Remediation Therapy in schizophrenia: a randomized controlled EEG–GSR study
papers.reason: The trial uses interactive visual oddball and 2-back working-memory tasks in schizophrenia, but the EEG results provide ERP amplitudes and frontal theta band-power summaries without detailed spectral or connectivity analysis.

papers.title: Vascular Cognitive Impairment and Vascular Dementia: A Literature Review
papers.reason: The review is relevant to early cognitive screening and diagnosis but does not present an interactive task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or computational cognitive model.
